post.originalText:
I asked Opus 5.5 one prompt: make a video highlighting key moments in the history of AI.

Research, script, animations, real recorded sounds, and all 5,160 frames coded by Claude.

Here’s 83 years of AI in 2 mins 52 secs. https://t.co/YWquVSQIYj
